status.description: Ready only when both unresolved arrays are empty and image_spec is complete.

design_rationale.description: Concise, human-reviewable explanation of why the design decisions answer the brief; it is not sent to the image renderer.

source_requirements.description: Outstanding sources; must be empty when status is ready.

clarification_questions.description: Blocking questions; must be empty when status is ready.

image_spec.description: Self-contained, renderer-ready instructions for GPT Image 2 when ready; null whenever blocked. Every decision that must be visible in the generated image must appear here rather than only in design_rationale.

communication_objective.description: What the finished image must communicate, stated without claiming an unverified audience effect.

audience_and_context.description: Who will encounter the image, where it will be used, and the viewing conditions that affect rendering decisions.

visible_copy.description: Exact strings permitted as visible artwork text. Preserve the user's wording and punctuation and do not propose additional copy.

composition.description: Concrete GPT Image 2 instructions for focal subject, supporting elements, visible relationships, hierarchy, placement, relative scale, framing, negative space, and crop safety.

typography.description: Concrete GPT Image 2 instructions for the hierarchy, placement, visual character, contrast, and legibility of visible_copy.

visual_treatment.description: Concrete GPT Image 2 instructions for visual medium, palette, materials, lighting, texture, imagery, and atmosphere; avoid unsupported abstract style praise.

allowed_variation.description: Rendering choices GPT Image 2 may vary without changing the design concept.

exclusions.description: Direct constraints naming content, text, styles, or artifacts that must not appear.
